contracts.name: Objective Ancestry
contracts.rule: Governed work SHALL preserve objective ancestry and reason context. Objective ancestry is explanatory context and MUST NOT grant authority.

contracts.name: Boundary-Based Decomposition
contracts.rule: A separate delegated task requires an ownership, permission, independent parallel-deliverable, hard-dependency/handoff, independent review/approval, or independent retry/recovery boundary.

contracts.name: Typed Dependencies
contracts.rule: Structural parentage MUST remain distinct from execution dependency. Hard dependency relations are typed and cycles fail closed.

contracts.name: Responsibility Scope Monotonicity
contracts.rule: A delegated principal's authority scope MUST be a subset of the delegating principal scope. Replan, retry, recovery and fallback MUST NOT expand it.

contracts.name: Execution Claim
contracts.rule: Runtime work SHALL use task-bound generation/idempotency claims. A stale heartbeat alone MUST NOT authorize takeover of a non-terminal claim.

contracts.name: Version-Bound Approval
contracts.rule: Approval SHALL bind object identity, revision, digest, scope and allowed operations. Superseded revision or digest MUST NOT inherit execution approval.

contracts.name: Budget Envelope
contracts.rule: Time, compute, memory, storage, network, provider-cost, token, retry and parallelism coordination budgets MUST be bounded and non-negative; HRB retains physical resource authority.

contracts.name: Liveness Separation
contracts.rule: Worker liveness, Temporal durable state and canonical Evidence/Gate verification are distinct states and MUST NOT be conflated.

contracts.name: Monitoring Non-Authority
contracts.rule: Control & Monitoring surfaces MAY inspect and request governed changes but MUST NOT directly bypass the owning authority.

contracts.name: Configuration Revision and Rollback
contracts.rule: Orchestration setting changes SHALL be revisioned, attributable and rollback-addressable; a rollback does not restore expired/revoked approvals.

contracts.name: Bounded Recovery
contracts.rule: Recovery SHALL be bounded and idempotent; unknown effect outcome MUST NOT be blindly replayed.

contracts.name: Temporal Singularity
contracts.rule: Temporal remains the sole global durable workflow lifecycle authority; delegated Conductors and runners own only bounded task-local execution state.
